body:
CHANGELOG updated in PARENA: Mouse wheel now routes to whichever pane (file-tree sidebar vs code editor) the cursor is hovering over, instead of always scrolling the code buffer. Fixed Spotlight's own scroll-past-view bug: Down past row 11 used to move the real selection off-screen with nothing visible changing -- added spotlight_scroll_offset + spotlight_keep_selection_visible so the selection always stays in the rendered window. Full suite clean, CI green on all 4 jobs. PARENA commit c3afbea, Apple #16448. session: sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e (sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e)

⚓ ☃
